prompt: Name someone who played on a Beatles recording but was not a Beatle.

answers.name: Billy Preston
answers.fact: Keyboards on Get Back — the only outside musician ever credited on a Beatles single label.

answers.name: George Martin
answers.fact: Producer, but also the piano solo on In My Life, sped up to sound like a harpsichord.

answers.name: Eric Clapton
answers.fact: Played the lead on While My Guitar Gently Weeps, uncredited at the time.

answers.name: Yoko Ono
answers.fact: Sang a line on The Continuing Story of Bungalow Bill.

answers.name: Nicky Hopkins
answers.fact: Electric piano on Revolution — one of the most-recorded session pianists in rock.

answers.name: Andy White
answers.fact: Session drummer on the album version of Love Me Do, with Ringo moved to tambourine.

answers.name: Brian Jones
answers.fact: The Rolling Stones guitarist played saxophone on You Know My Name.

answers.name: Mal Evans
answers.fact: The band's roadie, swinging the anvil on Maxwell's Silver Hammer.

answers.name: Alan Civil
answers.fact: French horn solo on For No One, recorded above the instrument's comfortable range.

answers.name: David Mason
answers.fact: Piccolo trumpet on Penny Lane, after McCartney heard him on TV.

answers.name: Anil Bhagwat
answers.fact: Tabla on Love You To, the first Beatles track built on Indian classical instrumentation.
